violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Ensure cutting boards at prep coolers are cleaned beneath. Trapped moisture and food.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Hot sandwich hold unit in C-store has buildup of dust and needs cleaning. Detail cleaning needed around line cooking equipment.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. To encourage proper hand washing, ensure hand sinks are provided with paper towels.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floor/wall around cooking equipment have buildup of debris and grease and need cleaning.
